summary_en: Toho Gas authorized acquisition of up to 20 million shares (5.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 17.0 billion yen through ToSTNeT-3 or market purchases from October 30, 2026 to April 30, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, the Board of Directors of Toho Gas Co., Ltd. resolved to acquire up to 20 million shares of the company's common stock, representing 5.7 percent of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 17.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through self-negotiated transactions on the ToSTNeT-3 system or open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the acquisition period running from October 30, 2026 to April 30, 2027.

The company cites the execution of flexible capital policy as the reason for the buyback authorization. As of October 28, 2026, the company held 14.3 million treasury shares against 351.9 million shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
